Plan ahead your staying in Riyadh

Relish traditional Najdi dishes

Numerous restaurants offer a taste of local Najdi culture, showcasing traditional cuisine within an authentic ambiance. These establishments are not just about the food; they feature beautiful antique décor and architectural details like unique murals, making them a popular draw for tourists and visitors eager to experience the heritage.

 

Feel the thrill of desert adventures

The desert surrounding Riyadh offers an exhilarating playground for adventure seekers. Imagine the rush of adrenaline, the sun beating down and the wind whipping through your hair. Quad biking across the seemingly endless expanse of golden sand provides a unique thrill, allowing you to explore the rugged terrain at your own pace.

 

Discover the skyscrapers 

Riyadh at night presents a striking scene: skyscrapers, brilliantly lit, pierce the dark desert sky, creating a beautiful contrast with the stars. The city's modern architecture becomes a luminous testament to its progress against the backdrop of the timeless desert.

 

More than shopping

You can never get bored in shopping in Riyadh city. You can shop indoor and outdoor.  There are open markets that assortment of international and local restaurants and cafes is highly rated by its visitors due to its fun and pleasant atmosphere.
